provenance.description: Curated recall gold set of 100 Meta-relevant platform/legal instruments. Compiled independently from public primary sources (EUR-Lex, US Code/Cornell LII, national legislation portals, regulator pages) and well-known statutory corpora. No dossier files under data/dossiers were read or copied.
selection_principles: Mix of low-obscurity anchors (GDPR, DMA, DSA, COPPA, CCPA, DMCA, ADA) and medium/high-obscurity instruments
Geographic spread: EU, US federal, multiple US states, UK/Ireland, Brazil, India, Australia, Canada, Japan, Korea, Singapore, South Africa
Domain coverage across privacy, competition, youth_safety, ip, accessibility
Prefer primary source_url when available; secondary official portals allowed
aliases capture common short names and alternate citations for matcher robustness

found_if_any: normalized citation key overlap (boilerplate-tolerant compact alnum)
normalized title/alias slug hit OR distinctive gold-alias token containment AND same domain_id AND compatible jurisdiction_id (exact or US-state under united_states)
